renderings.value: What Jansky had observed was the 14.6m wavelength radio wave from the Milky Way's core.
In that word is included the meaning of matching up to somebody's particular wavelength.
When an object moves away from Earth, the light that it is giving off is seen in longer wavelengths. When an object moves toward Earth, the light that it is giving off is seen in shorter wavelengths.
Violet light has a shorter wavelength than red light.
Are the only electromagnetic wavelengths that humans can directly perceive the light we see using our eyes and infrared radiation that warms our skin?
